reviews.title: Scam!!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Do not sign up for this service. In my experience, it is misleading and not transparent. It advertises a 7-day free trial, yet my card was charged a fee immediately. The trial offer did not match what was presented during signup.

Additionally, there is no readily available customer service phone number to address billing concerns, and the app does not function as advertised. Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others to proceed with caution and thoroughly review all terms before providing payment information.

reviews.title: DO NOT GET THIS!
reviews.text: Terrible customer service, went on to cancel because I decided I did not want to keep it as a lot of the bill readings came out inaccurate. Literally did this all within 10 minutes. Everything said that the subscription was canceled. Week later got charged for the premium plan for a year automatically which I never agreed to, and like I said had canceled and already removed the app at that. reviews.title: Needs a lot more work before it should have even been released.
reviews.text: I’ve used this app several times, but cancelled it soon after I paid the first year long subscription(now I know why they do that)after I “snapped” several bills that had incredibly unique serial numbers, which at this point is what most people are looking for. It will say you have a unique serial number, but it doesn’t say what kind, what the value is, or rate it on anything but the condition of the bill and how rare the certain denominations and years are, that’s it. It does nothing else. You could find out a lot more about a note with a free AI. Super frustrating.
